ction%20of%20the%20subject%20in%20this%20trial%20(see%20the%20values%20at%20the%20x%20and%20y%20axes).%20So%2C%20the%20order%20of%20the%20subject's%20foot%20steps%20were%3A%20MDwalk2_4%2C%20MDwalk2_1%2C%20MDwalk2_3%2C%20MDwalk2%2C%20and%20MDwalk2_2.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20The%20size%20of%20the%20pressure%20data%20across%20steps%20is%20not%20constant%2C%20the%20width%20varies%20from%2012%20to%2015%20columns%20and%20the%20length%20varies%20from%2030%20to%2032%20rows%20of%20data.%20Multiply%20these%20numbers%20by%200.846591%20cm%20to%20have%20the%20size%20of%20the%20pressure%20data%20in%20centimeters.%20Possible%20reasons%20for%20this%20variation%20are%3A%201.%20foot%20rotation%2C%202.%20differences%20at%20how%20the%20foot%20is%20supported%20at%20the%20ground%20at%20each%20step%2C%20and%203.%20perhaps%20measurement%20noise.%20So%2C%20one%20can't%20directly%20compare%20the%20images%20(the%20pressures)%2C%20for%20example%2C%20we%20can't%20average%20the%20data%20in%20order%20to%20get%20the%20mean%20foot%20pressure%20(or%20other%20statistics%20related%20to%20the%20positions%20of%20the%20steps)%3B%20we%20will%20have%20first%20to%20align%20the%20data%20(each%20step)%20and%20account%20for%20the%20different%20sizes.%20In%20image%20processing%2C%20this%20procedure%20is%20part%20of%20what%20is%20known%20as%20%5Bimage%20registration%5D(https%3A%2F%2Fen.wikipedia.org%2Fwiki%2FImage_registration).%20For%20the%20application%20of%20image%20registration%20to%20foot%20plantar%20pressure%2C%20see%20Pataky%20et%20al.%20(2008)%2C%20Oliveira%20et%20al.%20(2010).%0A%0A%20%20%20%20For%20now%2C%20given%20that%20there%20are%20only%20few%20steps%20and%20they%20seemed%20to%20be%20similar%2C%20we%20will%20only%20transform%20the%20images%20to%20have%20the%20same%20size.%0A%20%20%20%20%22%22%22)%0A%20%20%20%20return%0A%0A%0A%40app.cell(hide_code%3DTrue)%0Adef%20_(mo)%3A%0A%20%20%20%20mo.md(r%22%22%22%0A%20%20%20%20**Exercise%203%20%E2%80%94%20registration.**%20Two%20foot%20images%20have%20the%20same%20di
